lang.name: English
meta.title: Bot Management
lamp.degraded: Degraded mode: listening but no longer acting
banner.pending_restart: Settings are waiting to be applied. Applying restarts the bot: it leaves the channel and returns in about one minute.
banner.restart_confirm: Restart the bot to apply settings? It will leave the channel for about one minute.
banner.restarting: Restart requested. The bot will return in about one minute.
login.title: Log In
login.lede: Connect to the TeamSpeak server, choose your nickname: {bot} will send you a code. It appears as a popup in TeamSpeak (a poke) and in your private messages.
login.empty: No one is connected to the TeamSpeak server. Connect to the server: your nickname will appear here automatically.
login.help_who: Don't see yourself? Make sure you are connected to the right server: the list updates automatically.
login.code_sent: Code sent to {name}. Check TeamSpeak: a window popped up with the code (valid for {minutes} minutes). Or click the login link sent in your private messages by {bot}.
login.retry_auto: Automatic retry in a few seconds.
phrases.title: My Phrases
phrases.lede: What the bot transcribed from your voice, newest to oldest.
phrases.empty: No phrases yet: talk in the channel where {bot} is located.
actions.title: Actions
actions.lede: Every voice request: who asked, what was proposed, and the outcome.
actions.lede_member: The original sentence is only visible for your own requests.
actions.empty: No actions yet. Say "{bot}, …" in the channel to request one.
conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.lede: What {bot} heard in its channel while you were present with headset unmuted. What you couldn't hear never appears.
conversation.empty: Nothing yet. Join {bot}'s channel with your headset active, and the conversation will appear here.
services.title: Services
services.lede: The three background programs running {bot} on the machine. They restart automatically when the host boots.
services.empty: No services declared ([web] services in configuration).
services.web_restart_warn: The site will reload in a few seconds.
services.tsbot_restart_warn: The bot leaves the channel for about one minute.
live.title: Live Status
live.lede: Current bot status, channel presence, and active speaker. Conversation only appears if you can hear it.
live.channel_empty: No one else in the channel.
speak.title: Make Bot Speak
speak.lede: Preview the sentence here first, then say it in the channel. Sentences are synthesized once, then cached.
settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Changes are saved immediately and applied when you restart the bot via 'Apply'.
settings.saved_toast: Saved. Click 'Apply' for the bot to load them.
people.title: Identities & Exclusions
people.lede: Link a TeamSpeak client or server group to a player name. Only recognized players can trigger voice actions. Check 'Administrator' to grant access to all site pages.
people.exclusions_help: These users are never transcribed: their voice never reaches speech recognition.
people.help_footer: Dropdowns show users and groups currently online. A match by client UID takes precedence over server group.
people.toast_self_remove: You cannot remove your own row: you would lose access to these pages.
people.toast_validation: Assign a player name to each row, check 'Administrator', or remove it.
people.cannot_remove_own_admin: You cannot remove your own admin rights.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.lede: Plugins provide actions and knowledge (scores, rankings…) to the bot. Enable them, configure settings, then test connection.
plugins.saved_toast: Saved. Test runs with saved settings; 'Apply' passes them to the live bot.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.lede: Bot processing speed and channel activity metrics.
stats.speed_desc: Typical duration (half of requests are faster). 9 out of 10 in under {p90}, over {count} measurements.{failures}
stats.empty_speakers: No one spoke during this timeframe.
stats.empty_daily: No phrases recorded during this timeframe.
stats.empty_actions: No actions recorded during this timeframe.
logs.title: Logs
logs.lede: Bot activity logs: connections, transcribed phrases, replies, and errors. Displays up to the last 500 lines since startup.
logs.confirm_restart: Restart the bot? It leaves the channel for about one minute.
reasons.own_rights: You cannot remove your own admin rights.
presence.bot_offline: The bot is not connected right now.
presence.user_offline: You are not connected to the TeamSpeak server.
presence.deaf: Your headset is muted: you cannot hear the channel.
presence.hearing: You can hear the channel: conversation is displayed here.
presence.not_hearing: {reason} You only see what you could hear: nothing new will appear until you listen to the channel.
error.bot_down: The bot is not responding ({error}). It may be restarting.
error.code_throttled: A code was just sent: wait a few seconds before requesting another one.
error.person_not_connected: This person is no longer connected to the server.
error.code_expired: Code expired or never requested: please request a new code.
error.too_many_tries: Too many attempts: please request a new code.
error.code_incorrect: Incorrect code: check the 6 digits received in TeamSpeak.
error.identities_format: Each identity must map 'uid:…' or 'group:…' to a non-empty name.
error.plugin_empty_data: The plugin starts but receives no data: check the address and account.
error.no_systemd: No systemd on this machine: the Services page cannot work here.
error.cannot_stop_self: The site cannot stop itself: you would not be able to start it again. Use 'Restart'.
field.teamspeak.address.label: TeamSpeak Server Address
field.teamspeak.address.help: IP address or hostname, including ':port' if not default 9987.
field.teamspeak.server_password.label: Server Password
field.teamspeak.server_password.help: Leave empty if the server has none. Never displayed.
field.teamspeak.channel_password.label: Channel Password
field.teamspeak.channel_password.help: Only if the bot's channel requires a password. Never displayed.
field.teamspeak.nickname.label: Bot Nickname
field.teamspeak.nickname.help: Nickname shown in TeamSpeak. Keep '(recording)' or similar: users must know the bot is listening.
field.teamspeak.channel.label: Channel
field.teamspeak.channel.help: Channel path, for example 'Gaming/Lounge'. Empty = default server channel.
field.teamspeak.max_utterance_s.label: Max Utterance Slice Duration (s)
field.teamspeak.max_utterance_s.help: Long utterances beyond this duration are sliced into chunks of this length.
field.teamspeak.join_gap_ms.label: Utterance Stitch Gap (ms)
field.teamspeak.join_gap_ms.help: TeamSpeak stops voice transmission on brief pauses: chunks separated by less than this interval form one continuous sentence. Larger = more complete sentences, slightly slower bot response.
field.stt.model.label: Speech-to-Text Model
field.stt.model.help: Canary: forced language, preserves filler words, laughs, and French expressions. Parakeet: slightly faster, but guesses language and often misidentifies short sounds as English.
field.stt.vocabulary.label: Custom Vocabulary
field.stt.vocabulary.help: Names of games, tools, nicknames… Words sounding similar are corrected to the right spelling ('Gémini' → Gemini). Player names and nicknames are already included. One per line.
field.stt.laughs.label: Detect Laughter
field.stt.laughs.help: Adds '(rires)' to the sentence when someone laughs (small sound tagger on the host, nothing leaves it).
field.stt.laugh_threshold_pct.label: Laughter Sensitivity (%)
field.stt.laugh_threshold_pct.help: Lower = more laughs caught, a few false ones. Measured: real laughs 23-58, speech, coughs, typing 0-5.
field.stt.engine.label: Speech Recognition Engine
field.stt.engine.help: local: on the local host, nothing leaves the local network. gemini: Google transcribes with full context of player names (better with slang), but ALL channel speech is sent to Google. If Gemini fails, local takes over.
field.stt.gemini_model.label: Gemini Model for Transcription
field.stt.api_key.label: Gemini Transcription API Key
field.stt.api_key.help: Google AI Studio API key (aistudio.google.com). Empty = reuse the response model key.
field.stt.language.label: Spoken Language
field.stt.language.help: Language code enforced for Canary, e.g. fr or en. Ignored by Parakeet.
field.stt.min_utterance_ms.label: Minimum Utterance Duration (ms)
field.stt.min_utterance_ms.help: Sounds shorter than this (coughs, mic clicks) are discarded.
field.llm.enabled.label: Bot Replies and Acts
field.llm.enabled.help: Disabled: the bot only transcribes and archives.
field.llm.wake_words.label: Wake Words
field.llm.wake_words.help: Words that trigger the bot (its name at the beginning of a sentence). Test them: speech recognition must transcribe them accurately. One per line.
field.llm.personality.label: Personality
field.llm.personality.help: How the bot speaks and behaves: character, humor, preferences. It follows this tone guide, but never breaks its safety rules.
field.follow.enabled.label: Follow Players
field.follow.enabled.help: The bot automatically joins the channel with the most configured players (Identities page). If players split up, a second bot joins the other channel, then leaves when they regroup.
field.follow.nickname_2.label: Second Bot Nickname
field.follow.nickname_2.help: Keep '(recording)': people need to know it is listening.
field.llm.follow_up_s.label: Conversation Follow-Up Window (s)
field.llm.follow_up_s.help: After a bot response, users can continue talking without repeating its name during this window. 0 = always require the wake word.
field.llm.watch_for_actions.label: Propose Points Unprompted
field.llm.watch_for_actions.help: The bot listens to everything and speaks up on its own only to propose an action ('Bob won' → a point?), never to chat. Every sentence then goes to the LLM: only with a fast one (DeepSeek: 1 s, a few cents a night).
field.llm.confirm_timeout_s.label: Action Confirmation Timeout (s)
field.llm.confirm_timeout_s.help: Time allowed to confirm ('yes') after the bot proposes an action, before cancelling.
field.llm.warm_up.label: Warm Up at Startup
field.llm.warm_up.help: The LLM loads its prompt instructions once at startup: makes the first voice interaction much faster.
field.llm.base_url.label: LLM Server URL
field.llm.base_url.help: OpenAI-compatible server endpoint, for example http://127.0.0.1:8091/v1. For DeepSeek: https://api.deepseek.com, model deepseek-flash, key from platform.deepseek.com (sentences sent to the bot then go to DeepSeek).
field.llm.model.label: Model Name
field.llm.model.help: Sent to the LLM server; llama-server ignores it. For Gemini: e.g. gemini-flash-latest.
field.llm.api_key.label: LLM Server API Key
field.llm.api_key.help: Empty for local host model. For Gemini: Google AI Studio key, with base URL https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai — questions and recent context are sent to Google.
field.llm.thinking.label: Think Before Answering
field.llm.thinking.help: DeepSeek only. off: answers in about 1 s; on: slightly better, 2-3 s. auto: nothing is sent (local model, Gemini).
field.llm.timeout_s.label: Maximum LLM Timeout (s)
field.llm.timeout_s.help: Beyond this duration, the request is recorded as a failure.
field.llm.max_failures.label: Failures Before Degraded Mode
field.llm.max_failures.help: Consecutive LLM failures allowed before the bot enters degraded mode (still listens, stops acting).
field.llm.probe_interval_s.label: Degraded Mode Probe Interval (s)
field.llm.probe_interval_s.help: How often the bot rechecks LLM availability while in degraded mode.
field.voice.engine.label: Voice Engine
field.voice.engine.help: Phonon: most natural (falls back to Piper if unavailable). Piper: more robotic, always available.
field.voice.phonon_voice.label: Phonon Voice
field.voice.phonon_voice.help: Bot speaking voice. Preview in 'Make Bot Speak' after applying. 'default' = original female voice.
field.voice.piper_voice.label: Piper Voice
field.voice.phrases.degraded.label: Phrase: Degraded Mode
field.voice.phrases.degraded.help: Spoken when the LLM stops responding. Text or path to an audio file.
field.voice.phrases.restored.label: Phrase: Back to Normal
field.voice.phrases.cancelled.label: Phrase: Action Cancelled
field.voice.phrases.failed.label: Phrase: Action Failed
field.voice.phrases.invalid.label: Phrase: Request Not Understood
field.voice.phrases.unknown_speaker.help: Spoken when someone without a configured identity requests an action.
field.web.admin_groups.label: Site Administrator Server Groups
field.web.admin_groups.help: TeamSpeak server groups whose members can administer this site. One per line.
field.web.admin_uids.label: Additional Administrator UIDs
field.web.admin_uids.help: TeamSpeak client UIDs granted admin rights regardless of server groups. One per line.
